title: Raw tensor coordinate equation for the universal pullback counit
statement: Let $k:T\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with the recorded derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let $P,G$ be arbitrary cochain complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and let $\tau$ satisfy the canonical comparison predicate [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Write $\mu$ for the localization tensor map, $H=\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes G)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], and $\epsilon$ for the shared universal counit [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Every chain isomorphism $\phi:k^*H\cong\operatorname{Tot}(k^*P\otimes k^*G)$ whose maps on all tensor summands are the recorded module pullback tensor isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor] satisfies $Lk^*(\mu_X(P,G));\epsilon(H);Q(\phi)=\tau(QP,QG);(\epsilon(P)\otimes\epsilon(G));\mu_T(k^*P,k^*G)$. No K-flatness or invertibility of $\mu$ or $\epsilon$ is assumed.

proof.text: Prove pinnedComparison_natural for an additive functor with a natural module tensor isomorphism: precompose the desired chain equation by the inverse of the source comparison, check each total-complex coproduct summand with HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor.hom_ext, cancel the module tensor isomorphism, and use the two pinned summand equations and module tensor naturality. This proves the chain comparison naturality for the two specified comparisons, without requiring a separately chosen family.

Choose K-flat resolutions r:P0→P and s:G0→G with CochainComplex.exists_isKFlatResolution. Unpack IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison to obtain the pinned comparison ψ and its counit coordinate equation at P0,G0. Put t=Tot(r tensor s) and v=Tot(k*r tensor k*s). The first step gives k*(t);φ=ψ;v.

The localization tensor map is natural by Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural for the recorded Q lax structure (modelMap_natural). Naturality of the shared counit at t and the chain equality identify Lk*(Qr tensor Qs) followed by the desired left side with the known K-flat left side followed by Qv. Naturality of τ, naturality of the separate counits at r and s, tensorHom_comp_tensorHom, and target modelMap_natural identify the similarly precomposed right side with the K-flat right side followed by Qv. Postcompose the K-flat equation by Qv. Since Qr and Qs are isomorphisms, their tensor and its image under derivedPullback are isomorphisms; cancel that epimorphism. No ordinary pulled-back resolution map is asserted to be a quasi-isomorphism.

theorem tensorCounit_coordinateEquation
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (k : T ⟶ X)
    [@MonoidalPreadditive _ _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf)]
    (P G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X,
      (derivedPullback k).obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶
        (derivedPullback k).obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback k).obj B)
    (hτ : IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison k τ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory T.sheaf
    letI := Classical.choice (SheafOfModules.tensorClosed T.sheaf).1
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor X.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor T.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj X.sheaf
    letI := SheafOfModules.preservesZeroMorphisms_curriedTensor_obj T.sheaf
    ∀ φ : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (pullbackTensorTotal X P G) ≅
      pullbackTensorTotal T
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj G),
      (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).map
            (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor P G (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫
          φ.hom.f n =
        ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.module_pullback_tensor k)) (P.X p) (G.X q)).hom ≫
          HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj G)
            (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)))
            (.up ℤ) p q n h) →
      (derivedPullback k).map (pullbackTensorModelMap X P G) ≫
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit k).app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj (pullbackTensorTotal X P G)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map φ.hom =
        τ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G) ≫
          ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit k).app
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
            (SingleComplexBaseChange.counit k).app
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj G)) ≫
          pullbackTensorModelMap T
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj G)
